titulo: Myths about building your website yourself
hooks: Building it yourself with a free template?
Free can end up costing you a lot
DIY website? How hard could it be?
voz: A free template looks just as good. That same template is used by a ton of businesses, and yours ends up looking like all of them. I'll build it myself in a weekend. Then come the domain, the email, security and every fix. That weekend turns into a year.

tarjetas.mito: A free template looks just as good
tarjetas.realidad: Tons of businesses use it, and yours ends up looking like all of them

tarjetas.mito: I'll build it myself in a weekend

captions: Free templates are fine for trying things out. For a business that wants to sell, your website has to look like you and nobody else.
Building the website is the fun part. Then you have to connect the domain, set up email, handle security and fix whatever breaks. There goes the weekend, and a few more.
If you already tried building it yourself and it ended up half done, that happens a lot. The hard part starts after you pick the template.
